verdict.rationale: Reading a product's source under an open license is a fair question for an observability SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Datadog's product source is published under an open license. The only GitHub reference is the datadog-ci CLI repo, which states no license and is not the core product. A community comment contrasting Datadog with 'open-source alternatives' does not establish openness either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
